title: Render diagram executor
description: Renders text diagram sources to images via Kroki or per-type local commands.

file.description: Single workspace-relative diagram source file (atomized targets).

files.description: Multiple workspace-relative diagram source files (aggregate target).

output.description: Workspace-relative output image path for `file` (set by inferred targets; overrides outputDir templating).

outputs.description: Workspace-relative output paths parallel to `files` (set by inferred targets).

krokiUrl.description: Kroki base URL. Empty string disables Kroki (commands must cover all types).

commands.description: Per-type local command overrides. Placeholders (expanded shell-quoted — do not wrap in quotes): {input} {output} {format} {fileDir} {fileName} {projectRoot}.

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for commands and HTTP requests.

dryRun.description: Report planned outputs without rendering or writing.
